proposed.text: How should PV source and output circuits be treated when routed near feeders or branch circuits?

options.text: They may always be mixed with lighting branch circuits.
They must be routed only through plumbing shafts.
They are exempt from raceway and enclosure rules.
They should not share the same raceway, cable tray, outlet box, or junction box unless separated by a partition or connected together as permitted.
